page.title: Evade Roblox Quiz: 15 Questions on Nextbots, Controls and Revives
page.description_md: Think you know how to survive a Nextbot chase? These questions cover the warnings that tell you one is close, the PC keys you'll press every round, and how teammates bring a downed player back. Each attempt draws 15 questions, five from each difficulty.
page.seo_description: Test your Roblox Evade knowledge on Nextbot warnings, PC keyboard controls and teammate revives, from basic round rules to trickier rescue-item effects.
